title: The otel adapter resends the same log records every round while span export fails
goal: a round that sends the log records and fails on spans does not send those log records again: each signal keeps its own cursor, or log records carry an id the receiver dedups on

run:
import http.server,json,os,shutil,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,threading
U=shutil.which('uv') or sys.exit('uv is not on PATH')
GOT=[]
class Rq(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length') or 0));GOT.append(self.path)
        self.send_response(404 if self.path=='/v1/traces' else 200);self.send_header('Content-Type','application/x-protobuf');self.end_headers()
    def log_message(self,*a): pass
SV=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Rq);threading.Thread(target=SV.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
H=tempfile.mkdtemp();T=os.path.join(H,'c.sqlite')
E={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('OTEL_')}
E.update(CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=H,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.getcwd(),KB_COORD_STORE=T,OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT='http://127.0.0.1:%d'%SV.server_address[1])
for n in (1,2): s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','post','--kind','lesson','--field','ref=x%d'%n],capture_output=True,env=E,timeout=60)
s.run([U,'run','--frozen','--project','otel','python','otel/kbmon_otel.py','--count','3','--interval','1','--panel','coord','--store',T],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=300);SV.shutdown()
n=GOT.count('/v1/logs')
if n>1: print('the same log records were sent %d times while spans failed'%n);sys.exit(1)
print('ok: log records sent once (%d posts)'%n)

notes: SP-qvlnptiw review (ST-gj4eicfw g1 changed to a cursor per signal): one shared cursor moves only when every signal that is on was sent, so a receiver that refuses /v1/traces gets duplicate log records.
